name: RAGBench
description: RAGBench is a large-scale benchmark dataset for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems across five industry-specific domains with 100k examples. It includes the TRACe evaluation framework for explainable and actionable metrics.
reputation: A well-known large-scale RAG benchmark that has been used to evaluate retrieval, generation, and explainability across multiple domains.
notes: Covers diverse industry corpora such as user manuals; first comprehensive RAG benchmark with explainable labels.
